sentence_quote: The appellant filed a notice seeking leave to appeal his sentence of three years and four months.
note: Conviction appeal dismissed, leave to appeal sentence denied.

offence_note: Three counts of second-degree murder of family members
sentence_quote: I hereby sentence you on each count to imprisonment for life without eligibility for parole until you have served 15 years of your sentence.
note: Joint submission accepted; court declined to recommend hospital setting; victim surcharge waived.

offence_note: Impaired driving causing bodily harm, failing to stop, refusing blood sample
sentence_quote: I would therefore allow the appeal only to the extent of making the six months' sentence on Count 3 concurrent with that on Count 5.
note: Global sentence reduced from 3.5 to 3 years; driving prohibition not shown.

sentence_quote: For the offence of dangerous driving causing death, I sentence you to 12 months imprisonment.
note: CSO considered and rejected; DNA order declined.

offence_note: Two break and enters, possession of break-in instrument
sentence_quote: service of Mr. Rees’s four-year sentence imposed on January 29, 2018 commenced on that date and will continue until it expires.
note: Four-year term unchanged; held concurrent with sentence already being served.

sentence_quote: I would grant leave, but dismiss the appeal.
note: Guilty plea noted but not discussed as mitigating.

offence_note: Conspiracy to traffic in cocaine and cannabis
sentence_quote: I would allow the Crown’s appeal of the 20-month sentence for conspiracy to traffic in cocaine and impose a sentence of 42 months imprisonment.
note: Balance of 42 months stayed because already served 20 months; 18-month concurrent cannabis sentence undisturbed.

offence_note: Manslaughter of spouse by one punch
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal but would dismiss the appeal.
note: Nine years imposed; Crown says effectively twelve with 18 months pre-sentence custody.

offence_note: Sexual assault and administering stupefying drug by youth
sentence_quote: The appellant was sentenced to 90 days custody, split between 60 days in open custody and 30 days of supervision, followed by a year of probation.
note: Youth Criminal Justice Act sentence; conviction and sentence appeals dismissed.

offence_note: Six break and enters of dwelling-house, one attempted
sentence_quote: I would vary the appellant’s sentence to a term of 15 months’ imprisonment followed by two years of probation.
note: Trial ancillary orders left in effect but not specified; co-accused acquitted.
